title: NBC: Iran preparing for war to resume, eyeing new targets and shift in tactics
detail: NBC News reports that Iran is preparing for hostilities to resume, looking at new targets and a shift in military tactics. Only the headline was available in the feed; specifics of the targets and tactics are not disclosed and the report is unverified.

title: Iran says its missiles are no longer bound by range limits
detail: Iran International reports that Iran says its missiles are no longer bound by range limits. Only the headline was available in the feed; specifics are not disclosed and the claim is unverified.
